name: io.github.stevemilton/payagent-mcp
description: Gives AI agents a wallet: pay x402 APIs (USD + EUR), check balances, self-onboard in one tool call.

environmentVariables.name: ARISPAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ArisPay developer API key (ap_live_… / ap_test_…). Optional — the create_user tool can self-provision one from just an email, or set PAYAGENT_PRIVATE_KEY to sign locally with no account.

environmentVariables.name: PAYAGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key for permissionless local signing (zero-signup mode): pay_api signs x402 payments with it directly — no ArisPay account needed. Generate one with `npx payagent wallet new`. Never sent to any server.
